name: Chamamé
label: CHAMAME
source: Gimenez (UNA) 2025, accordion left hand as played by Villareal, Florentin, Spicher, Schivert; Romero Garcia (U. Distrital, Bogota) 2017 fig. 12, guitar estilo correntino; tempo a practice default

sources.title: Gimenez, El acordeon del Litoral argentino. Un analisis de los distintos modos de acompanamiento en el chamame (Revista del IIMCV, UNA, 2025, vol. 2 num. 27)
sources.shows: 6/8 as two beats of three eighths: bajos on the 1st and 3rd eighth, acordes on the 2nd and 5th eighth, the 5th accented and short; nothing on the 4th and 6th (Villareal, Imagen 1; same in Florentin, Spicher's first mode, Domingorena, Baez, Schivert)

sources.title: Romero Garcia, Chacarera, zamba y chamame: tres generos ... y su interpretacion en la guitarra (Universidad Distrital Francisco Jose de Caldas, Bogota, 2017), p. 43 fig. 12
sources.shows: Chamame correntino on guitar, 6/8: the 1st and 3rd eighth with the index finger alone (low notes, marking the 3/4), the 2nd and 5th eighth marked with index, middle and ring in a block; it also adds the chasquido on the 4th and 6th eighth, left out here because Gimenez has rests there
